{{Top|leg}}
The '''Symatrum League''' was a protest group. It was one of the more peaceable members of the [[Coalition of Automaton Rights Activists]]. Led by [[Bethelia Halvala]], the Symatrum League staged non-violent picket lines outside the offices and plants of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturers.
